kicker: Dental practices, veterinary clinics and the groups that run them
lede: Thirty-two small agents that check a dental practice's or veterinary clinic's back office from the files it already exports, insurance claims and remittances, treatment and recall gaps, missed charges, controlled drug logs, pharmacy, plans, deposits and payroll, and wait for one named person before anything is billed, sent or changed.
packages: Claims aging and follow-ups, ERA posting against the 835, pre-authorizations, PPO fee schedules, write-offs by PPO (5 agents)
Unscheduled treatment and benefits left, recall and hygiene reappointment gaps, patient balances, membership plans, no-shows (5 agents)
Production and collections by provider, hygiene production per hour, lab cases and invoices, supply cost, sterilization log gaps (5 agents)
Treatment sheet against invoice, reference lab send-outs, estimates against invoices, boarding and grooming, discounts by staff (5 agents)
Veterinary pharmacy and controlled drugs pack
Controlled drug log against counts, inventory expiry and shrink, pharmacy margins, supply cost (4 agents)
Vaccine reminders, wellness plan billing and use, pet insurance claims, client balances, no-shows (5 agents)
Card batches against deposits, payroll against collections, licence and DEA expiries, referrals, review replies (5 agents)

For dental support organisations, veterinary groups and firms serving many practices: all 32 agents, one shared setup, every location mapped; $1,000 per location above 10
support: Support after setup: $200 a month for one pack, $450 a month for a whole practice or hospital, $250 a month per location for partner rollouts. Covers export changes, new settings, new versions and a monthly check-in call.
notes: Column layouts for Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, Curve, Denticon, AVImark, Cornerstone, ezyVet, Covetrus Pulse and Shepherd were written from knowledge and are confirmed on your own exports at setup.
Thresholds such as follow-up days, filing limits, margins and payroll targets are your settings, not anyone's rules.
Sterilization and controlled drug checks report what your logs show; they never decide whether a rule is met.
Vaccine due dates come from your practice system; no agent decides what care a patient or pet needs.

Tested on fictional data, and four agents also on public files (a state licence file, a state Medicaid sample 835, CMS drug acquisition costs, a state Medicaid dental fee schedule). No real practice's, patient's or client's data was used.
Not clinical, legal, tax, coding or compliance advice.
warn: Dental files are protected health information: a business associate agreement is signed before we hold any file. Everything runs on your computer from files you export, patient, pet and client names are masked before results reach the AI model, and nothing is billed, filed, refunded, paid, posted or changed in your practice system: drafts wait for one named person.
